fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner present. The change set's intent names the fix: the plan workflow's merge step, which fails when origin/main moved past the checked head, should loop back to rebase within a cap, as ship-change's merge does (on.fail = rebase-merge, max_visits = 3). The planner placed the change set under milestone 25 (empty backlog: bugs and polish), as the sibling fix 01M6M1M1 is, and planned one leaf under plan-workflow: plan.toml's merge step goes back to rebase on fail, the rebase/wait-rebased/rebased-green/merge loop capped at 3 visits like ship-change, proven by a Go workflow transition test and a testscript modelled on run-ship-merge-main-moved.txtar. Nothing left open.
fields.title: Plan of Fix Plan runs fail at merge (autonomous)
